versions.changelog:
Initial release of the make-motion-comic skill.

- Create low-cost motion-comic videos from story/script using AI-generated keyframes, multi-character Chinese TTS, captions, and FFmpeg assembly.
- Ensures character identity consistency, professional voice quality, smooth motion, and independently editable assets.
- Provides a structured workflow: script/shot writing, identity locking, keyframe generation, TTS voice production, precise timeline/timing, and final video rendering.
- Default video format is 9:16, 1080×1920, 30 fps, 45–90s, with 6–12 keyframes and post-rendered captions.
- Includes quality checks for image consistency, hand anatomy, subtitle safety, audio balance, and deliberate/non-jittery motion.
- Requires dependency check before media production, and supports reviewable, reusable production assets for episodic work.
